headline: Zimmer Biomet Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

The Company reported second quarter net sales of $2.177 billion, an increase of 4.8% over the prior year period, an increase of 4.7% on a constant currency1 basis and an increase of 4.0% on an organic constant currency1 basis. Net earnings for the second quarter were $198.3 million, or $399.6 million on an adjusted1 basis.
